description: VaaniEdge closed-loop corpus: the 4 official IISc evaluation prompts plus representative assistant responses in English and Hinglish. Consumed by app/src/test/.../ClosedLoopFixtureTest.kt (exact Kotlin codec + G2P) and speech_lab/verify_closed_loop.py (VITS -> Whisper round trip).

utterances.text: What is the weather forecast for Bangalore tomorrow?
Can you set a reminder for my meeting at 5 PM?
Mujhe kal subah 7 baje ka alarm set karna hai.
Aaj ka schedule kya hai, aur meri next meeting kab hai?
Tomorrow in Bangalore, expect thunderstorms with a high of 28 degrees and a low of 20 degrees.
Kal Bangalore mein baarish ki sambhavna hai, temperature 20 se 28 degree tak rahega.
Done, I have set a reminder for your meeting at 5 PM.
Theek hai, maine aapki meeting ke liye 5 PM ka reminder set kar diya hai.
Your alarm is set for 7 AM tomorrow morning.
Aapka alarm kal subah 7 baje ke liye set ho gaya hai.
Today you have three meetings, and your next one is the lab review at 4:30 PM.
Aaj aapki teen meetings hain, aur aapki next meeting 4:30 PM par lab review hai.
